tools.name: search_crew
tools.description: Counts reachable UK event crew for a role near a town or postcode and lists a few examples as first name and last initial with town. Returns no contact details.

tools.name: get_pay_guidance
tools.description: Returns CrewPool's own figures for what UK event crew are offered and ask for, with the source page.

tools.name: draft_job
tools.description: Saves a held draft job and emails the hirer a confirmation link. Nothing is posted and no crew are contacted until the hirer opens that email and confirms.

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Reads whether a saved draft has been confirmed and, once live, how many people said yes, as first name and last initial with town and match. Never returns contact details.
